No, it isn't automatic. Signing up and opening an Albert Investing account shows you which randomly selected stock you're eligible for, but to receive the $1,000 in stock you must complete all of these:

- Complete the signup flow to create an Albert account
- Subscribe to the Genius AI tier
- Create an Albert Investing account
- Deposit at least $10,000 within 90 days of opening your account
- Keep your Genius AI subscription and your account in good standing for at least 12 months

The help center passage I have cuts off while describing the 12-month requirement, so check the full offer terms in the app for any other conditions.
